hints.title: Horizontal Layer Node Partitioning
hints.text: Visiting an arbitrary branching tree breadth-wise groups all elements residing at identical vertical distances into distinct sublists.

hints.title: Queue Breadth Snapshots
hints.text: At the start of each level iteration, record the number of nodes currently residing in the queue. Pop that exact count of nodes and collect all their non-null children.

hints.title: Level Order BFS Blueprint
hints.text: Initialize result = [] and queue = deque([root]). While queue has elements: loop over current queue length; popleft(); append val to level list; push each child in curr.children to queue. Append level list to result.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Every node and child pointer is enqueued and dequeued exactly once.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simple pre-order traversal mixes levels together unless augmented with depth tracking maps.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Queue memory is bounded by the maximum width of any level layer.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Clean snapshot iteration using the fixed queue length at the start of each level.
